vectors.intent_statement: Preserve reviewer-runnable evidence that the career slice credits only attributed work and never infers reserved answers or submits.
Authorize and gate the local career evidence slice without discovery, submission or external-write authority.
Specify a local career evidence engine that derives role matches and application packages only from recorded work, with explicit participation and human-reserved attestations.
Expose the career evidence engine's public entry points.
Allow `python -m apps.career` to run the local CLI.
Bound every application step by an explicit J0-J5 tier so answers a human must give are never inferred or auto-submitted.
Run the passport, match, dossier and package stages locally, writing only to a new output directory.
Compile an application package in which every claim traces to passport evidence and every reserved answer stays with the human.
Explain why a role fits, what to lead with and, mandatorily, what must not be claimed.
Keep who did the work and how it is known explicit, so a claim can never outgrow its evidence.
Turn local git history into participation-classified evidence, crediting a person only for work they authored or integrated.
Normalize supplied postings into canonical job entities and typed requirements the matcher can evaluate without guessing.
Map each job requirement to the passport evidence that does or does not support it, instead of a single opaque score.
Aggregate participation-classified evidence into a per-capability Career Passport that states its own limits.
Name the capabilities both work evidence and job requirements resolve to, so matching compares like with like.
Make the career tests importable as a package.
Require the career behavior suite and at least 80 percent measured statement coverage per module.
Prove participation-honest attribution, requirement coverage, mandatory do-not-claim lists, reserved-answer handling and claim provenance.
Provide synthetic postings covering supported, partial, unmapped, tenure, credential and reserved requirements.

Provide synthetic application questions mixing evidence-answerable and human-reserved classes.

Name every SRS code a branch may claim, and where its spec lives.
Keep the measured repository inventory aligned with the newly registered career scope.
Distinguish reviewed source fingerprints from execution or deployment evidence.
